senses.gloss: कर (I) a. (f. रा or री) (generally at the end of compounds) Who or what does or makes or causes, e.g. भयंकर, वृद्धिकर, दुःखकर.

कर (II) m. 1. A hand, M.v.136, R.ii.31, Megh.i.41; 2. a ray of light, प्रतिकूलतामुपगते हि विधौ विफलत्वमेति बहुसाधनता । अवलंबनाय दिनभर्तुरभूव पतिष्यतः करसहस्रमपि Sis.ix.6 (where the word is used in senses 1 and 2), Megh.i.39; 3. the trunk of an elephant, सेकः सीकरिणा करेण विहितः M.M.ix.; 4. hail; 5. a tax, a toll, a tribute, (ददौ) अपरांतमहीपालव्याजेन रघवे करम् R.iv.58, M.vii.128, 129; 6. a particular measure of length equal to 24 thumbs; 7. the constellation called हस्त.
कर (I) a. (f. रा or री) (generally at the end of compounds) Who or what does or makes or causes, e.g. भयंकर, वृद्धिकर, दुःखकर.
कार (I) a. (f. री) (at the end of a compound) Making, doing, working &c., e.g. कुंभकार, वार्तिककार, स्वर्णकार, यज्ञकार.

कार (II) m. 1. Act, action, e.g. पुरुषकार; 2. a term designating a sound or a word which is not inflected, अकार M.ii.76, 125; 3. effort, Sis.xix.27; 4. determination; 5. religion austerity; 6. a husband, a master; 7. power, strength; 8. a tax, a toll; 9. a heap of snow; 10. the Himālaya mountain.
कारा f. 1. Imprisonment, confinement; 2. a prison-house, a jail; 3. part of a lute below the neck; 4. pain, affliction; 5. a female messenger.

करण (II) n. 1. Doing, performing, executing, Yaj.iii.308; 2. act, action; 3. an organ of sense, वपुषा करणोज्झितेन सा निपतंती R.viii.38, 42, Megh.i.5; 4. the body, उपमानमभूद्विलासिनां करणं यत्तव कांतिमत्तया K.S.iv.5; 5. an instrument; 6. a cause, a motive; 7. the idea expressed by the instrumental case (in gram.) (thus defined- क्रियायाः परिनिष्पत्तिर्यद्व्यापारादनंतरम् । विवक्ष्यते यदा यत्र करणं तत्तदा स्मृतम्); 8. a document, a bond, documentary proof (in law), M.viii.51; 9. a division of the day (in astrology); 10. beat of the hand to keep time (in music), K.S.vi.40; 11. an instrumental cause (in logic). (व्यापारवदसाधारणं कारणं करणम् T.S.)

कारण n. 1. A cause, i.e. that which is invariably antecedent to some product and is not otherwise constituted (in phil.); according to the Naiyāyikas it is of three kinds, viz., (1) समवायि (intimate or inherent) as threads are of a cloth; (2) असमवायि (non-intimate or non-inherent) as the conjunction of the threads is of cloth; (3) निमित्त (instrumental) as the weaver’s loom is of cloth; 2. cause, reason, R.i.74, Bg.xiii.21; 3. instrument-means, Yaj.iii.20, 65; 4. motive, R.xvi.22, M.viii.347, Yaj.ii.203; 5. the origin or plot of a play or poem; 6. a sign, a document, a proof, an authority, M.xi.84; 7. that on which an opinion or judgment is founded; 8. an organ of sense; 9. element, Yaj.iii.148; 10. the body.

कर्ण-क्ष्वेड m. a constant noise in the ear (in medicine).

कर्ण-जाह m. the root of the ear, अपि कर्णजाहविनिवेशिताननः M.M.v.
कर्ण-जित् m. Arjuna, the third Pāṇḍava prince.
कर्ण-ताल m. the flapping of the elephant’s ears, R.ix.71.
कर्ण-धार m. a helmsman, a pilot, e.g. अकर्णधारा जलधौ विप्लवंतेह नौरिव.
कर्ण-धारिणी f. a female elephant.
कर्ण-पथ m. the range of hearing.
कर्ण-परंपरा f. going from ear to ear.
कर्ण-पालि f. the lobe of the ear.
कर्ण-पाश m. a beautiful ear.
कर्ण-पूर m. 1. an ear-ring, an ornament of flowers worn on the ears, यस्याश्चोरश्चिकुरनिकरः कर्णपुरो मयूरः Pr.R.i.; 2. the Aśoka tree.
कर्ण-पूरक m. 1. the Kadamba tree; 2. the Aśoka tree; 3. the blue lotus; 4. an ear-ornament.
कर्ण-प्रांत m. the lobe of the ear.
कर्ण-भूषण n. an ear-ornament.
कर्ण-भूषा f. an ear-ornament.
कर्ण-मूल n. the root of the ear, R.xii.2.
कर्ण-मोटी f. a form of Durgā.
कर्ण-वंश m. an elevated platform of bamboo.
कर्ण-वर्जित (I) a. earless.
कर्ण-वर्जित (II) m. a snake.
कर्ण-विवर n. the auditory passage of the ear.
कर्ण-वेध m. piercing the ear to receive ear-rings.
कर्ण-वेष्ट m. an ear-ring.
कर्ण-वेष्टन n. an ear-ring.
कर्ण-शष्कुली f. the outer part of the ear, Na.ii.8.
कर्ण-शूल m.n. earache.
कर्ण-श्रव a. audible, loud, M.iv.102.
कर्ण-श्राव, -संश्रव m. running at the ear, discharge of ichorous matter from the ear.

कर्ण-सू f. Kuntī, the mother of Karṇa.
कर्ण-हीन (I) a. earless.
कर्ण-हीन (II) m. a snake.

कर्णिक m. A steersman.
कर्णिका f. 1. An ear-ring; 2. the pericarp of a lotus; 3. the middle finger; 4. a fruit-stock; 5. the tip of an elephant’s trunk; 6. chalk; 7. a pen, a small brush.
कर्णिकार (I) m. 1. The name of a tree, किं कर्णिकारकुसुमैर्न हृतं मनोज्ञैः Rt.vi.21; 2. the pericarp of a lotus.

कर्णिकार (II) n. A flower of the Karṇikāra tree (Kālidāsa had thus moralized over it- वर्णप्रकर्षे सति कर्णिकारं दुनोति निर्गंधतया स्म चेतः । प्रायेण सामग्र्यविधौ गुणानां पराङ्मुखी विश्वसृजः प्रवृत्तिः K.S.iii.28), Rt.vi.6.
कर्णिन् m. 1. An ass; 2. an arrow of a particular shape.
कर्णी f. 1. An arrow of a particular shape; 2. name of the mother of Mūladeva, the father of the science of theft.
कर्णी-रथ m. a covered litter for the conveyance of women, कर्णीरथस्थां रघुवीरपत्नीम् R.xiv.13.
कर्णी-सुत m. Mūladeva, father of the science of theft, कर्णीसुतप्रहिते च पथि मतिमकरवम् D.K., कर्णीसुतकथेव संनिहितविपुलाचला Kad.
कर्तन n. 1. Cutting, Yaj.ii.229, 286; 2. spinning cotton or thread.
कर्तनी f. Scissors.
कर्तरिका f. 1. A knife; 2. a small sword; 3. scissors.
कर्तरिका f. 1. A knife; 2. a small sword; 3. scissors.

कर्तव्य (I) a. (f. व्या) 1. What ought to be done, हीनसेवा न कर्तव्या कर्तव्यो महदाश्रयः Cāṇakya.; 2. what ought to be cut, destroyed, put down, पुत्रः सखा वा भ्राता वा पिता वा यदि वा गुरुः । रिपुस्थानेषु वर्ततः कर्तव्या भूतिमिच्छता Bh.
कर्तव्य (II) n. Duty, task.

कर्तृ m. 1. The supreme spirit; 2. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 3. of Viṣṇu; 4. of Śiva; 5. a doer in general; (it should be translated according to context. See M.iii.160, iv.172, viii.345, R.ii.64.); 6. agent (considered as the meaning of the nominative case) (in gram.).
कर्त्री f. 1. A knife; 2. scissors.
कर्द m. Mud.
कर्द m. Mud.
कर्दम (I) m. 1. Mud, slime, सरितः कुर्वती गाधाः पथश्छाश्यानकर्दमान् R.iv.24; 2. dirt, filth; 3. sin.
कर्दम (II) n. Flesh.
कार्दम a. (f. मी) Muddy, filled or covered with mud.
कर्दम-आटक m. a receptacle for filth.
कर्पट m.n. 1. Old or ragged garment; 2. a dirty garment; 3. a garment coloured red.
कार्पट m. 1. A petitioner, a suitor, a candidate; 2. a rag.
कर्पटिक a. (f. का) wearing a ragged garment.
कर्पटिक a. (f. का) wearing a ragged garment.
कार्पटिक m. 1. A pilgrim; 2. one who subsists by carrying water from holy rivers; 3. a caravan of pilgrims; 4. an experienced man.
कर्पण m. A kind of weapon, चापचक्रकणपकर्पणप्रासपट्टिशमुषलतोमरादिप्रहरणजालमुपयुंजानः D.K.
कर्पर m. 1. An iron sauce-pan, a frying-pan; 2. a piece of a broken jar, तस्मै वहेयमुदकं घटकर्परेण Ghat.22; 3. the skull; 4. a kind of weapon.
कर्पास m.n. The cotton plant.
कार्पास (I) a. (f. सी) Made of cotton.
कार्पास (II) m.n. 1. Any thing made of cotton, M.viii.326; 2. paper.
कार्पास (III) f. The cotton plant.
कर्पासी f. The cotton plant.
कार्पास (I) a. (f. सी) Made of cotton.
कार्पासिका f. The cotton plant.
कर्पूर m.n. Camphor, कर्पूरपूगपरिपूर्णमुखीं स्मरामि Ch.P.8.
कर्पूर-खंड m. a field of camphor.
कर्पूर-तैल n. Camphor-liniment.
कर्फर m. A mirror.
कर्बु a. Variegated, Yaj.iii.166.
कर्बुर (I) a. (f. रा) Variegated, spotted, पवनैर्भस्म कपोतकर्बुरम् K.S.iv.27.
कर्बुर (II) m. 1. The variegated colour; 2. sin; 3. a demon; 4. the Dhattūra plant.
कर्बुर (III) n. 1. Gold; 2. water.
कर्बुर (I) a. (f. रा) Variegated, spotted, पवनैर्भस्म कपोतकर्बुरम् K.S.iv.27.

कर्मन् n. 1. Action, deed; 2. performance, office; 3. moral duty; 4. a religious rite; (it is either नित्य, नैमित्तिक or काम्य); 5. product, result; 6. natural active property, as maturity of heat; 7. performance of religious rites, as opposed to speculative religion; 8. the object of an action (in gram.), कर्तुरीप्सिततमं कर्म Pan.; 9. motion considered as one of the seven categories of things (in the Vaiśeṣika phil.) (thus defined- एकद्रव्यमगुणं संयोगविभागेष्वनपेक्षकारणं कर्मः; it is five-fold- उत्प्रेक्षणं तथावक्षेपणमाकुंचनं तथा । प्रसारणं च गमनं कर्माण्येतानि पंच च); 10. fate, i.e. a certain consequence of former acts, e.g. कर्मणो गहना गतिः.
कर्मन्-अक्षम a. incapable of business.
कर्मन्-क्षम a. able to perform a task or duty, आत्मकर्मक्षमं देहं क्षात्रो धर्म इवाश्रितः R.i.13.
कर्मन्-अंग n. part of a sacrificial rite, as प्रयाज of the Darśa sacrifice.
कर्मन्-अधिकार m. the right of performing religious rites.
कर्मन्-अनुरूप a. 1. according to action or function; 2. in accordance with actions done in a previous birth.
कर्मन्-अंत m. 1. work, administration of an office or business; 2. the end of any task; 3. a barn, a store of grain &c. M.vii.62; 4. cultivated ground.
कर्मन्-अंतर n. 1. difference or contrariety of action; 2. penance; 3. expiation.
कर्मन्-अंतिक (I) a. final.
कर्मन्-अंतिक (II) m. a workman.
कर्मन्-आजीव m. one who lives by the profession of an artisan.
कर्मन्-आत्मन् (I) a. endowed with principles of action, active, M.i.53.
कर्मन्-आत्मन् (II) m. the soul.
कर्मन्-इंद्रिय n. an organ of action; (they are- वाक्पाणिपादपायूपस्थानि, M.ii.91. See इंद्रिय).
कर्मन्-उदार n. any honourable or valiant act, magnanimity, prowess.
कर्मन्-उद्युक्त a. busily engaged.
कर्मन्-कर m. 1. a hired labourer, a servant who is not a slave, कर्मकराः स्थपयादयः Panch.i.; 2. Yama.
कर्मन्-कार m. 1. one who works for wages, a workman; 2. an artisan, a mechanic; 3. a blacksmith, हरिणाक्षि कटाक्षेण आत्मानमवलोकाय । न हि खड्गो विजानाति कर्मकारं स्वकारणम् Ud.; 4. a bull.
कर्मन्-कर्तृ m. an agent who is at the same time the object of the action (in gram.) (क्रियमाणं तु यत्कर्म स्वयमेव प्रसिद्यति । सुकरैः स्वैर्गुणैः कर्तुः कर्मकर्तेति तद्विदुः).
कर्मन्-कांड m.n. that department of the Veda which relates to ceremonial acts and sacrificial rites.
कर्मन्-कारिन् m. a labourer, a workman.
कर्मन्-कार्मुक m.n. a strong bow.
कर्मन्-कीलक m. a washerman.
कर्मन्-क्षेत्र n. the land of religious acts, viz., भरतवर्ष.
कर्मन्-घात m. leaving off work.
कर्मन्-चंडाल m. 1. a name of Rāhu; 2. a man of low acts or deeds; (the following four persons are called कर्मचंडाल- असूयकः पिशुनश्च कृतघ्नो दीर्घरोषकः । चत्वारः कर्मचंडालाः).
कर्मन्-चोदना f. 1. the motive impelling to ritual acts; 2. any positive precept which enjoins a religious act.
कर्मन्-ज्ञ m. one acquainted with religious rites.
कर्मन्-त्याग m. abandonment of worldly duties or ceremonial rites.
कर्मन्-दुष्ट a. corrupt in action, immoral, disrespectable.
कर्मन्-दोष m. 1. sin, vice, M.vi.61; 2. error, defect, M.i.104; 3. evil consequence of human acts; 4. discreditable conduct.
कर्मन्-धारय m. name of a compound, a subdivision of तत्पुरुष, e.g. तत्पुरुष कर्मधारय येनाहं स्यां बहिव्रीहिः Ud.
कर्मन्-ध्वंस m. 1. loss of benefit arising from religious acts; 2. disappointment.
कर्मन्-नामन् n. a participial noun (in gram.).
कर्मन्-नाशा f. the name of a river.
कर्मन्-निष्ठ a. given to the performance of religious rites.
कर्मन्-पथ m. a source of action.
कर्मन्-पाक m. ripening of actions, recompense for acts done in a former life.
कर्मन्-प्रवचनीय m. a term for certain prepositions, particles, or adverbs not connected with a verb but with a case of a noun, e.g. अनु in ‘सर्वं मामनु ते.’ (See उपसर्ग, गति and निपात).
कर्मन्-न्यास m. relinquishment of the results of religious rites.
कर्मन्-फल n. recompensed actions, (e.g. pain, pleasure &c.).
कर्मन्-बंध m. confinement to repeated birth, as the result of good or bad acts.
कर्मन्-बंधन n. confinement to repeated birth, as the result of good or bad acts.
कर्मन्-भू, भूमि f. 1. the land of religious rites, viz., भारतवर्ष; 2. ploughed ground.
कर्मन्-भू, भूमि f. 1. the land of religious rites, viz., भारतवर्ष; 2. ploughed ground.
कर्मन्-मीमांसा f. the same as मीमांसा q.v.
कर्मन्-मूल n. a kind of sacred grass called कुश.
कर्मन्-युग n. the fourth age of the world, i.e. the Kaliyuga.
कर्मन्-योग m. 1. performance of worldly functions and religious duties; 2. active exertion, industry.
कर्मन्-वश m. fate considered as the inevitable consequence of actions done in a former life.
कर्मन्-विपाक See कर्मपाक.
कर्मन्-शाला f. a workshop.
कर्मन्-शील, -शूर a. assiduous, laborous.
कर्मन्-शील, -शूर a. assiduous, laborous.
कर्मन्-संग m. attachment to worldly functions.
कर्मन्-सचिव m. a minister, a deputy.
कर्मन्-संन्यासिक, -संन्यासिन् m. an ascetic who expects no return for religious deeds performed.
कर्मन्-संन्यासिक, -संन्यासिन् m. an ascetic who expects no return for religious deeds performed.

कर्मन्-साक्षिन् m. one who witnesses the good or bad actions of man; (there are nine divinities that witness all human actions- सूर्यः सोमो यमः कालो महाभूतानि पंच च । एते शुभाशुभस्येह कर्मणो नव साक्षिणः).
कर्मन्-सिद्धि f. accomplishment of any object, success, K.S.iii.57.
कर्मन्-स्थान m. a public office or place of business.
कर्मठ (I) a. (f. ठा) Skilful in work, clever, working diligently.
कर्मठ (II) n. The director of a sacrifice.

कर्मण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) Skilful, clever.
कर्मण्या (II) f. Wages.
कर्मंदिन् m. An ascetic.
कर्मार m. A blacksmith, Yaj.i.163.
कर्मिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Working; 2. one who performs religious rites with the expectation of some result, कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी नस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन Bg.vi.46.
कर्मिन् (II) m. An artisan, Yaj.ii.265.
कर्मिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Working; 2. one who performs religious rites with the expectation of some result, कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी नस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन Bg.vi.46.
कर्मिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Skilled in business.
कर्मिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Skilled in business.
कर्वट m. The market-town of two hundred or four hundred villages.
कर्ष (I) m. 1. Drawing, dragging, Yaj.ii.217; 2. attracting; 3. ploughing; 4. a furrow, a trench.
कर्ष (II) m.n. A weight of gold or silver equal to sixteen māshas.
कार्ष m. A husbandman, a cultivator.
कर्ष-आपण m. the same as कार्षापण q.v.

कर्षक m. A husbandman, Yaj.ii.265.
कर्षण n. 1. Drawing, dragging, bending, भज्यमानमतिमत्रकर्षणात् R.xi.46, vii.62; 2. attracting; 3. ploughing; 4. emaciation, M.vii.112.
कर्षिणी f. The bit of a bridle.
कर्षू (I) f. 1. A furrow; 2. a river, a canal.

कारक-दीपक n. a figure of speech in which the same कारक is connected with a series of verbs as in खिद्यति कूणति वेल्लति विचलति निमिषति विलोकयति तिर्यक् । आंतर्नंदति चुंबितुमिच्छति नवपरिणया वधूः शयने K.Pr.x.

कारण-माला f. a figure of speech thus defined- यथोत्तरं चेत् पूर्वस्य पूर्वस्यार्थस्य हेतुना तदा कारणमाला स्यात् K.Pr.x.
कारण-वादिन् m. a complainant, a plaintiff.
कारण-वारि n. the original water produced at the beginning of the creation.
कारण-विहीन a. without a cause.
कारण-शरीर n. the inner rudimentary body or causal frame (in Vedānta phil.).
कारणिक a. (f. का) An examiner, a judge.
कारणिक a. (f. का) An examiner, a judge.
कारंडव m. A sort of duck, तीरनलिनीं कारंडवः सेवते Vikr.ii.
कारव m. A crow.
कारा-अगार, -गृह n. prison-house, a jail, कारागृहे निर्जितवासवेन लंकेश्वरेणोषितमाप्रसादात् R.vi.40, Sant.S.iv.10.
कारा-अगार, -गृह n. prison-house, a jail, कारागृहे निर्जितवासवेन लंकेश्वरेणोषितमाप्रसादात् R.vi.40, Sant.S.iv.10.
कारा-गुप्त m. a prisoner.
